name: YYLO CLI
free_limit: Free and open-source (MIT) command-line orchestrator for AI coding agents, repeatable workflows, and receipt-backed repository changes; unlimited local use for any number of projects.
watch_out: Runs locally in a terminal rather than as a hosted service: requires Node.js 20.10+, Git, and your own model provider or API key; no cloud dashboard, team plan, or hosted tier.
